verdict.rationale: Kommo's API documents a method to add leads with their contacts and companies in batches, which is a first-party bulk operation. The evidence shows only batch creation of leads. Missing for 10: bulk update/delete across many items, bulk operations for other entity types, UI-level mass actions, documented batch limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The method allows you to add leads with contacts and a company to your account in batches.
